subject: Acme SIG intake: CI approval runbook, secret rotation matrix, and artifact ownership
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acmecorp.com>, security-intake@acmecorp.com
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme SIG intake: CI approval runbook, secret rotation matrix, and artifact ownership

Hi team,

Acme's assessor opened a quick SIG intake and asked for a compact set of artifacts focused on our SDLC controls (code review sampling, CI gating, secret rotation, and change approvals). They want an intake package they can drive straight into their review queue — think checklist + representative artifacts, not the entire repo.

Can each of you own the items below and drop the artifacts as stubs into the shared Intake folder (see links below) by EOD Monday 4/19? Acme flagged a compliance window; I promised a first-pass within three business days.

Requested deliverables (minimal, redactions ok):
- Code review sampling: list of 10 merged PRs from the last 90 days with reviewer attestations and PR links (owner: Ben)
- CI/CD approval policy: pipeline job definitions, merge-gate rules, and an example approval log (owner: Monica)
- Secrets rotation: KMS/HSM rotation schedule, last rotation timestamps, and the ephemeral-token sampling matrix (owner: Monica)
- Change/runbook: one-page rollback playbook for a model-serving release + delegation matrix (owner: Avery)
- Short narrative (one paragraph) describing how prefix/KV caching and canary rollouts are handled in-hosted vs dedicated (owner: Avery)

Please include these as filename stubs (we'll attach logs where allowed):
- pr-sampling-list-202704.pdf
- ci-job-matrix.csv
- kms-rotation-schedule.xlsx
- change-runbook-v1.md

Notes / constraints:
- Redact commit contents if the customer needs it; they typically accept PR metadata and reviewer names.
- For CI logs, avoid including secrets or token values — provide hashes or job ids.
- If we need to escalate for wider access, call out blockers in replies so I can loop in Legal/Security.

Elena — copied you so the intake tracker has a point of contact. If Acme has a template preference, let us know.

Thanks,

Avery Johnson
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
avery@redwood.com
(attachment placeholders: change-runbook-v1.md, ci-job-matrix.csv)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme SIG intake: CI approval runbook, secret rotation matrix, and artifact ownership

Thanks Avery — I can take the code review sampling.

Quick plan: I'll pull the last 90 days of merged PRs for the services Acme called out (inference-runtime, routing, and orchestration). I'll include: PR title, PR link, author, reviewer(s), merge timestamp, and the reviewer note / LGTM line. I'll redact diffs and any tokens. Expect a 10-PR PDF and a short manifest CSV.

Attached: pr-sampling-list-202704.pdf (stub) — full PR metadata will be uploaded to the intake folder. If the assessor needs a higher sample size, say +10, please let me know.

Ben Carter
Principal Engineer, Platform
ben@redwood.com
(attachment: pr-sampling-list-202704.pdf)

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acmecorp.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme SIG intake: CI approval runbook, secret rotation matrix, and artifact ownership

On Thu, Apr 15, 2027 at 9:12 AM Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com> wrote:
> Acme's assessor opened a quick SIG intake and asked for a compact set of artifacts focused on our SDLC controls...

I'll take the CI/CD and secrets pieces. Summary and artifacts uploaded to the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cACME-intake

What I uploaded (stubs):
- ci-job-matrix.csv — mapping of pipeline jobs to repo, required approvals, and OIDC connector IDs (no secrets in file)
- kms-rotation-schedule.xlsx — rotation cadence for KMS keys used by inference and telemetry (last rotation dates redacted to month/year)
- quick-note.md — short explanation of ephemeral-token sampling (we take a weekly sample of ephemeral tokens issued via our short-lived vault role; audit events retained for 90 days in the audit ledger)

A couple of clarifications for Acme:
- Our merge-gate requires at least one approved reviewer and the CI gate to pass; for high-risk services (runtime & model routing) we require two reviewers.
- OIDC/OAuth connector metadata is provided; we will not share client secrets — we provide connector IDs and vendor cert fingerprints instead.

If Elena or security-intake want a non-redacted artifact under NDA, we can escalate. Otherwise these should be sufficient for the assessor's initial pass.

Monica Patel
Engineering Manager, Platform Security
monica@redwood.com
(attachments: ci-job-matrix.csv, kms-rotation-schedule.xlsx)

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acmecorp.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 14:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme SIG intake: CI approval runbook, secret rotation matrix, and artifact ownership

Avery / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the intake artifacts. The format is exactly what the assessor flagged as helpful (manifest + one-page playbooks). A few quick asks from our side before we close the ticket: 

1) Can you add the PR sampling manifest as a CSV as well as the PDF (some tools ingest CSVs)?
2) For the KMS schedule, can you add the key alias used for model-serving (alias/models-primary) so we can correlate with our key inventory? If that requires an NDA, confirm the escalation path.
3) For the change-runbook, a short bullet on who can approve an emergency rollback (roles and escalation phone/email) would be helpful.

If you prefer, I can raise an NDA request from Acme Legal and tag security-intake so we can receive the non-redacted logs. Otherwise, the redacted stubs will be fine for the initial assessor review.

Elena Torres
Sr. Security Operations Manager
Acme Corp
elena.torres@acmecorp.com
security-intake@acmecorp.com
